documents.title: Harborline Systems, Inc. — Confidential Information Memorandum (Excerpt)
documents.triage_summary: Seller marketing material excerpt stating management representations on growth, revenue quality, retention, EBITDA, DSO, contracts, and strategy; useful to identify represented claims and seller narrative but not as independent proof.

documents.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Northwind Retail Group, Inc.
documents.triage_summary: Executed customer master services agreement for Northwind; primary contractual evidence for assignment/change-of-control, renewal mechanics, and commercial relationship terms relevant to contract diligence and concentration follow-up.

documents.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Vantage Grocers LLC
documents.triage_summary: Executed customer MSA for Vantage Grocers; primary contractual evidence for MFN language, assignment rights, renewal terms, and service-level related provisions relevant to retention and contract-risk analysis.

documents.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Pinnacle Outdoor Brands, Inc.
documents.triage_summary: Executed customer MSA for Pinnacle Outdoor; primary contractual evidence for assignment, pricing discount, and escalator provisions, useful for contract term validation and cross-source checks against management summaries and board materials.

documents.title: RESELLER AND DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Atlas Distribution GmbH
documents.triage_summary: Executed reseller/distribution agreement for Atlas Distribution; primary evidence for territorial exclusivity, European channel structure, termination economics, and assignment provisions relevant to strategy and channel conflict review.

documents.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems, Inc. and Cascade Foods Holdings LLC
documents.triage_summary: Executed customer MSA for Cascade Foods Holdings; primary contractual evidence for current term and assignment rights, and useful contextual evidence regarding lapse and re-engagement when assessing retention and expansion narratives.

documents.title: Customer Contract Summary — Top Accounts
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems - Office of the CFO
documents.triage_summary: Management-prepared portfolio contract summary covering top accounts and selected term flags; useful as a routing aid and statement of management position, but downstream agents should prefer executed agreements for contractual conclusions.

documents.title: Adjusted EBITDA Bridge — Management View
documents.prepared_by: Harborline Systems - Office of the CFO
documents.triage_summary: Management-prepared EBITDA bridge and adjustment schedule showing reported EBITDA, proposed adjustments, and rationales; relevant to earnings diligence as a representation of management's normalization approach rather than independent verification.
